name: bookshelf-server
comment:deps: Every dependency here MUST be pure JavaScript. The Dockerfile builds in a
--platform=$BUILDPLATFORM stage and copies node_modules into the target-arch
runtime stage, so a native binary would be the wrong architecture on arm64.
Do NOT add: sharp, canvas, @napi-rs/canvas, better-sqlite3, bcrypt, or
node-vibrant / get-image-colors (which depend on sharp or canvas).
Image decoding uses jpeg-js + pngjs; password hashing uses node:crypto scrypt.
